item.title: Splendora High School students earn spots in TMEA All-State Band
item.description: Eleven Splendora High School band students competed in the final round of auditions at the Texas Music Educators Association Area Auditions on Saturday, Jan. 10.

item.title: Brenda Lea Clark
item.description: Brenda Lea Clark, age 76, of Dayton, Texas, passed away peacefully on Jan. 9, 2026. She was born on Jan. 22, 1949, in Houston, Texas, to Henry Clifford Long and Floy Conner. Brenda was a lifelong resident of Dayton. She grew up attending First Baptist Church of Dayton. She devoted several years of service to the Liberty County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: Barbara Ann Randall Mitchell
item.description: Barbara Ann Randall Mitchell, 88, of Saratoga Texas, died on Jan. 11, 2026, at Harbor Hospice House in Beaumont, Texas. Barbara was born on Jan. 17, 1937, to Mamie and Everett Randall in Beaumont, Texas. Barbara was a resident of Saratoga for the last 57 years. She was a longtime member of West End Baptist Church and retired from West Hardin CCISD after 28 years, where she touched the lives of many students. item.title: Janie Arias Cruz
item.description: Janie Arias Cruz, age 72, went home to God on Jan. 8, 2026, surrounded by her family in her final moments. Born on April 21, 1953, in Sugar Land, Texas, Janie was the beloved first-born child of Domingo Arias and Sanina Rodriguez Garcia.​As a preteen, Janie stepped into a motherly role for her siblings, a testament to her nurturing spirit that defined her entire life. At 16, she met Isabel "Bunior" Cruz. After a sweet courtship, they were married on May 5, 1971.

item.title: TxDOT reports progress on Trinity River Bridge and Old & Lost Bridge repairs
item.description: Work continued last week on the maintenance project underway at the Trinity River Bridge and the Old & Lost Bridge, with crews making significant progress during the week of Jan. 5. According to project updates provided by the Texas Department of Transportation, crews prepared the bridge surface by blasting and grinding, removing old striping, and setting forms for a new polymer overlay. item.title: Suspect arrested after allegedly damaging, burglarizing O'Reilly Auto Parts in Cleveland
item.description: Cleveland police arrested a suspect late Sunday after responding to a report of a suspicious person at O’Reilly Auto Parts. Officers were dispatched at approximately 11:34 p.m. Sunday, Jan. 11, to O’Reilly Auto Parts, 909 N. Washington Ave. Upon arrival, witnesses reported seeing a male suspect breaking into the store’s delivery trucks.

item.title: Gulf Inland Logistics Park, Dayton mayor discuss Dayton’s bright future
